name: Mental

features.name: Fire Frames

features.name: Free spins

review: Mental is one of Nolimit City's most notorious slots: disturbing asylum theme, layered modifiers and a 66,666x max win. The base game is frequently quiet, and the bonus can either fizzle or explode depending on how multipliers stack. It's exactly the kind of game that's worth learning in demo mode first – the feature interactions take a few bonuses to understand.
cons: Disturbing theme is not for everyone
